name: Bamum Script
notes: Invented by King Njoya of the Bamum Kingdom (Cameroon), starting 1896, evolving through six documented stages over c. 14 years from an initial ~465-pictogram system to a true syllabary by 1902. Suppressed after French colonial administration took over in 1919 (materials destroyed, teaching banned); undergoing documented revival since 2022. `latest: null` reflects the ongoing revival rather than continuous unbroken use.
